name: compliance-mcp
description: Mechanical, fully offline compliance/document checkers as MCP tools: bid quotations, contract consistency, invoice, trade documents, three-way match, expense claims, bank reconciliation. Every finding quotes the source line and is recomputable. 招投标/合同/票据/外贸单证/三单匹配/报销/银行对账 的确定性核对工具。
author: 河南樵夫网络科技有限公司
//: 引擎文件是 CommonJS（scripts/engines/*.js），因此这里刻意不写 "type":"module"——写了会让它们被当成 ESM 而全部加载失败。server.mjs 用 .mjs 后缀，本身就是 ESM。
